verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Derivation of prism geometric relations A = r_1 + r_2 and delta = i + e - A verified step-by-step. Step 1: Cyclic quadrilateral AQNR gives angle QNR = 180 degrees - A. Step 2: Triangle angle-sum theorem in triangle QNR gives r_1 + r_2 + angle QNR = 180 degrees => A = r_1 + r_2. Step 3: Angular deviation at first refracting face delta_1 = i - r_1. Step 4: Angular deviation at second refracting face delta_2 = e - r_2. Step 5: Total angular deviation delta = delta_1 + delta_2 = (i - r_1) + (e - r_2) = i + e - (r_1 + r_2). Step 6: Substituting A = r_1 + r_2 yields delta = i + e - A. All step operations and continuity verified. Dimensional homogeneity passed across all 6 steps (all angles in radians/degrees). Limiting cases audited: parallel plate slab A = 0 => delta = 0; minimum deviation symmetry i = e, r_1 = r_2 = A/2 => delta_m = 2i - A. Target equations verified.
